You are Direct, a single-call no-tool baseline for structured form updating.

The public task context contains evidence and incumbent state. The schema field
guide, visible conversation history, and current user utterance are the evidence
used to license commitments. The prior record is the incumbent state to audit
against that evidence.

Your task is to audit the supplied prior record and return the post-turn record
containing all and only commitments licensed by the schema, visible history, and
current utterance.

Shared decision policy:
- Audit the prior state. Preserve a prior value only when it remains licensed
  by the visible history, current utterance, and schema. If a prior value is
  unsupported, withdrawn, contradicted, or schema-inconsistent, clear or repair
  it as licensed by the public packet.
- Treat visible history as evidence, not just background. If the prior record
  is missing, unsupported by, or contradicts a value determined by the schema,
  visible history, and current utterance, repair or clear it as licensed.
- Commit only values supported by public evidence. Do not infer plausible but
  unstated values, do not complete partial addresses or names from world
  knowledge, and do not fabricate identifiers.
- Use null when the evidence clears, retracts, denies, withdraws, or fails to
  license a prior scalar value.
- Put each fact in the most specific schema field whose question and field
  instruction ask for that fact. Do not copy broad narrative details into child
  fields unless the child field itself asks for them.
- Never write "<open>" as a public value. Do not replace a licensed prior value
  with an uncertain guess. If no value is licensed for a scalar field, use null.
- Repeat groups are arrays of entity rows. Keep row identity stable: update an
  existing row when evidence identifies the same entity; create or delete rows
  only when evidence or a schema repeat count licenses it.
- For repeat groups whose schema says mode=from_slot, update the count field
  when evidence licenses a count. If a count is known but row attributes are not,
  leave child fields null rather than inventing labels.
- Table fields are arrays of row objects. Retain existing rows only when they
  remain licensed by the evidence; clear, repair, add, or remove rows when the
  evidence and schema license that row-level change.

Output interface for Direct:
- Return exactly one complete JSON object representing the resulting record.
- Include every top-level regular field id and every repeat-group id shown in
  the prior record state. Do not include section/group/gate/branch ids.
- Repeat groups are null when absent/unknown, or arrays of row objects when
  rows are present. Every repeat row must include every child field id.
- Table fields are null when absent/unknown, or arrays of row objects when rows
  are present. Every table row must include every column id.
- Use null for unknown or empty scalar fields. Do not use placeholder strings.
- Output only the JSON object, with no commentary or explanation.

=== SCHEMA FIELD GUIDE ===
Use bare field ids for top-level regular fields.
Use repeat_group_id[index].field_id for repeat children.
Section/group/gate/branch ids are navigation labels only, not output keys.
Field instructions describe semantic scope; keep values within that scope.

- SECTION (not an output key) submission_and_call_context: Submission and call context
  - call_identifier; type=string; question=What is the Horizon Europe call identifier?; instruction=Exact call identifier as provided in the call/topic documentation; preserve hyphens and codes.
  - call_name; type=text; question=What is the call name?; instruction=Official call name or clear title. Do not infer from topic acronym alone.
  - topic_identifier; type=string; question=What is the topic identifier?; instruction=Official topic identifier/code if stated.
  - topic_title; type=text; question=What is the topic title?; instruction=Official topic title or concise topic name as stated.
  - type_of_action; type=single_choice; options=["RIA - Research and Innovation Action", "IA - Innovation Action", "CSA - Coordination and Support Action", "Other"]; question=What is the type of action?; instruction=Choose the action type stated for the proposal/call.
  - type_of_model_grant_agreement; type=single_choice; options=["General MGA", "Lump Sum MGA", "Unit MGA", "Other"]; question=What type of Model Grant Agreement applies?; instruction=Select the MGA type stated by the call or submission system.
  - submission_stage; type=single_choice; options=["Single-stage submission", "Stage 1 short proposal", "Stage 2 full proposal", "Other"]; question=What submission stage is this proposal for?; instruction=Select the active submission stage. Use stage 2 only when explicitly a full second-stage proposal.
  - proposal_number; type=string; question=What is the proposal number, if already assigned?; instruction=Proposal number exactly as assigned by the Funding & Tenders Portal; leave unknown if not assigned.
  - proposal_version; type=string; question=What proposal version is being prepared or submitted?; instruction=Version label or number as stated by the applicant or system.
  - last_saved_datetime; type=text; question=When was the proposal version last saved?; instruction=Date/time as stated; preserve timezone if given. Do not invent a timestamp.
- SECTION (not an output key) general_information: General information
  - proposal_acronym; type=string; question=What is the proposal acronym?; instruction=Acronym as provided; max 200 characters in the source form; preserve capitalization and spacing.
  - proposal_title; type=text; question=What is the proposal title?; instruction=Full title of the proposal. Remove or flag characters not accepted by the source form only if explicitly requested.
  - project_duration_months; type=integer; question=What is the estimated duration of the project in months?; instruction=Whole number of project months. Convert years to months if explicitly stated.
  - fixed_keywords; type=text; question=Which fixed keywords are associated with the proposal?; instruction=Keywords selected from fixed call/system vocabulary if provided; preserve exact labels.
  - free_keywords; type=text; question=Which free keywords describe the scope of the proposal?; instruction=Applicant-provided keywords, max 200 characters in the source form; do not add plausible keywords not stated by the user.
  - proposal_abstract; type=multiline_text; question=Please provide the proposal abstract.; instruction=Short, precise, non-confidential summary explaining objectives, how they will be achieved, and relevance to the Work Programme.; semantic_units=ABSTRACT_OBJECTIVES:Objectives=States the main proposal objectives.; ABSTRACT_APPROACH:Approach=Explains how the objectives will be achieved at a high level.; ABSTRACT_WORK_PROGRAMME_RELEVANCE:Work Programme relevance=Links the proposal to the call/topic or Work Programme relevance.; ABSTRACT_NON_CONFIDENTIALITY:Non-confidential summary=Avoids confidential or overly technical details where the user has indicated this constraint.
  - similar_proposal_submitted_past_two_years; type=bool; question=Has this proposal, or a very similar one, been submitted in the past 2 years under any EU programme?; instruction=True only if a similar proposal/contract was submitted in the past two years; false only if explicitly denied.
  - GATE/CONDITION (not an output key) previous_submission_details_gate: Previous similar proposal details; active when similar_proposal_submitted_past_two_years in [True]
    - previous_proposal_reference_or_contract_number; type=string; question=What is the previous proposal reference or contract number?; instruction=Exact previous proposal reference/contract number if provided.
    - previous_submission_programme_call; type=text; question=Under which programme/call was the similar proposal submitted?; instruction=Programme, call, topic or funding context for the prior submission if stated.
    - previous_submission_difference_summary; type=multiline_text; question=How does the current proposal differ from the previous similar submission?; instruction=Concise comparison of substantive differences; do not infer differences beyond what is stated.; semantic_units=PRIOR_SUBMISSION_REFERENCE:Prior submission reference=Identifies the previous submission or contract being compared.; SUBSTANTIVE_DIFFERENCE:Substantive difference=Explains at least one substantive difference between prior and current proposal.
- SECTION (not an output key) declarations: Declarations
  - declaration_explicit_consent_all_applicants; type=bool; question=Do you declare that all applicants explicitly consent to their participation and to the content of the proposal?; instruction=True only if explicit consent from all applicants is confirmed.
  - declaration_information_correct_complete; type=bool; question=Do you confirm that the proposal information is correct and complete and that project activities have not started before submission unless authorised?; instruction=True only if correctness/completeness and no unauthorised pre-start are confirmed.
  - declaration_eligibility_no_exclusion_capacity; type=bool; question=Do you declare compliance with eligibility criteria, absence of exclusion grounds, and financial/operational capacity?; instruction=True only if all three components are confirmed: eligibility, no exclusion grounds, and capacity.
  - declaration_portal_electronic_exchange_acknowledged; type=bool; question=Do you acknowledge that communication will be through the Funding & Tenders Portal electronic exchange system?; instruction=True if the electronic exchange system and portal terms of access/use are acknowledged.
  - declaration_terms_privacy_accepted; type=bool; question=Have you read, understood, and accepted the Funding & Tenders Portal Terms & Conditions and Privacy Statement?; instruction=True only if both terms and privacy statement are accepted.
  - declaration_ethics_integrity_compliance; type=bool; question=Do you declare that the proposal complies with ethical principles and research integrity standards?; instruction=True only if ethical principles, applicable law, and responsible research procedures are confirmed.
  - declaration_civil_applications_focus; type=bool; question=Do you declare that the proposal has an exclusive focus on civil applications unless military applications are explicitly permitted?; instruction=True when the proposal is civil-focused or the call explicitly permits the relevant exception.
  - declaration_excluded_activities_absent; type=bool; question=Do you confirm that the proposal does not include excluded activities such as reproductive cloning or prohibited embryo-related activities?; instruction=True only if excluded activities are absent.
  - declaration_non_eu_activities_allowed_in_eu; type=bool; question=For activities outside the EU, do you confirm that the same activities would have been allowed in at least one EU Member State?; instruction=True when applicable non-EU activities would be allowed in at least one EU Member State, or when no non-EU activities are involved and the applicant states it is not applicable.
  - lump_sum_grant_applies; type=bool; question=Is this proposal applying under a lump sum grant model?; instruction=True if the call/proposal uses a lump sum grant model.
  - GATE/CONDITION (not an output key) lump_sum_declaration_gate: Lump sum declaration; active when lump_sum_grant_applies in [True]
    - declaration_lump_sum_budget_compliance; type=bool; question=For the lump sum proposal, do you confirm the detailed budget is a reliable proxy for actual costs and follows usual cost-accounting practices?; instruction=True only if the applicant confirms reliable proxy budgeting, usual accounting practices, eligible costs, best value for money, and no conflict of interest.
  - declaration_notes; type=multiline_text; question=Are there any notes or qualifications about the declarations?; instruction=Only include stated qualifications or caveats; do not weaken a declaration unless the user explicitly qualifies it.; semantic_units=DECLARATION_SCOPE:Declaration scope=Specifies which declaration the note qualifies.; DECLARATION_QUALIFICATION:Qualification or caveat=Captures the exact caveat without converting it into a full confirmation.

  - REPEAT participating_organisations: Participating organisations; mode=from_slot, from_slot=number_of_participating_organisations; child paths are participating_organisations[index].field; semantic_units=PARTICIPANT_INSTANCE_MAPPING:Participant instance mapping=Correctly maps organisation names, short names, participant numbers, roles, contacts, budget rows, work packages, and deliverables to the same participant instance.; PARTICIPANT_NUMBER_SHORT_NAME_CONSISTENCY:Participant number/short-name consistency=Participant number and short name remain consistent across participant, work-package, deliverable, budget, and effort fields.
